scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "uv run python backend/manage.py runserver 8000" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.test: uv run python backend/manage.py test planner && npm run test --workspace frontend -- --run
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && uv run pywrangler deploy
